title: The second mile
summary: Jesus forms a people who answer pressure with surplus kindness, not retaliation.
application: When pressed today, choose one concrete second-mile response instead of matching force with force.

title: Love under hostility
summary: Patience under pressure includes blessing those who oppose you.
application: Pray once by name for someone who frustrates you before you speak to or about them.

title: Learn from the gentle One
summary: Jesus invites the weary to learn gentleness and humility from him.
application: Trade one anxious push for a quiet ask: “What would Jesus’ pace look like in this moment?”

title: Do to others under stress
summary: The measure of love is how we treat others when we are interrupted or depleted.
application: Give one person the response you would want if roles were reversed.
